TITLE: Civil Engineer
SUMMARY: Civil Engineer with 4+ years of hands-on experience in QA/QC, materials engineering, field inspections, and construction quality control across heavy civil infrastructure, highway construction, NATM tunneling, TBM-bored tunnels, and underground structures. Experienced in field and laboratory testing of soil, aggregates, cement, concrete, shotcrete, and grout in accordance with project specifications and applicable IS, ASTM, DIN, and EN standards. Skilled in rock bolt pull-out testing, shotcrete thickness testing, concrete strength testing, tunnel excavation, ground support systems, earthwork, drainage, pavement construction, shaft excavation, grouting, and track bed concreting. Proficient in reviewing construction drawings, specifications, inspection and test plans, and material test results; preparing QA/QC reports and inspection records; identifying nonconformities; and coordinating corrective actions with contractors, site teams, and client representatives. Experienced in field observation logging, construction monitoring, quality documentation, and site safety compliance, with working knowledge of AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Bluebeam.
